The Prodigi Print API (v4.0) is a RESTful, JSON-based API for global print-on-demand fulfillment. It lets merchants create and manage print orders, request real-time quotes for pricing and shipping, and query the product catalogue by SKU. Orders progress through Prodigi's fulfillment stages, with per-order callbacks pushing status and shipment updates to a merchant-supplied callback URL.
